newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Bucaram announces cabinet shakeup.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram announces cabinet shakeup.

text.p: Ecuador's President Abdala Bucaram said on Thursday he had accepted the resignation of three government ministers and a senior administration official as part of a cabinet shakeup.

Bucaram said in an address to the nation that Energy Minister Alfredo Adum, Government Minister Frank Vargas, Social Welfare Minister Adolfo Bucaram and Administration Secretary Miguel Salem were leaving the cabinet.
The president said the cabinet changes were made in response to widespread popular opposition to economic and social policy.
"I will carry out a broad renewal of officials and relations in order to tune in to the needs of the country," Bucaram said.

Trade unions and students groups staged sometimes violent protests after the government scrapped subsidies for public utility tariffs on Jan. 8, causing big hikes in electricity, gas, public transport and telephone rates.
Bucaram, whose possible dismissal was scheduled to be debated in a special afternoon session by Congress, said Thursday he would reconsider the tariff rises.
